Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting members of certain nonprofit conservation corps programs from the prevailing wage provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting members of certain nonprofitconservation corps programs from the prevailing wage provisions; andadding a new section to chapter 39.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The requirement to pay prevailing wages under this chapter does notapply to participants in Americorpsaffiliated nonprofit conservationcorps programs if: (1) The program's management and administrative headquarters are inWashington state; (2) The program participants either: (a) Are members of Americorps who receive a living allowance thatis specified in federal or state law; or (b) Perform service work in the same capacity as Americorps membersand receive a similar living allowance; (3) The participants in the program primarily engage inenvironmental restoration and trail construction work; and p. 1 HB 2475 (4) At least ten percent of the participant's time in the programis devoted to education and training
